documentation.content: No automatic Cloud SQL backup has succeeded in 30 hours (it runs once a night inside a four-hour window from 02:00 Doha time, so 24 to 28 hours apart is normal). First step: `gcloud sql backups list --instance alyr-db` and `gcloud sql operations list --instance alyr-db --limit 5`; check the instance's backup setting was not switched off. Take a backup by hand with `gcloud sql backups create --instance alyr-db`.

conditions.displayName: No successful automatic backup in 30 hours
